subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway onboarding own a Workers AI endpoint/model selector, or should Workers AI remain a documented custom-provider setup until the broader Cloudflare bridge is designed?
rationale: The fix changes provider-owned onboarding, model-choice UX, generated config shape, endpoint/auth semantics, and overlap with the broader Cloudflare bridge issues, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Fold Into Cloudflare Bridge
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 as the canonical design and keep this issue as the onboarding acceptance criterion for Workers AI support.

options.title: Add Narrow Workers AI Mode
options.body: Add a provider-owned non-interactive endpoint/model mode that generates `/workers-ai/v1` OpenAI-compatible config for explicit `@cf/...` models without solving the full bridge first.

options.title: Document Custom Provider Path
options.body: Publish an exact supported `custom-api-key` command/config for Workers AI and close this once the bundled Cloudflare auth choice is intentionally scoped to Anthropic passthrough.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Cloudflare Bridge
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94554 as the canonical design and keep this issue as the onboarding acceptance criterion for Workers AI support.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced the provider setup and did the plugin-boundary refactors most relevant to choosing the owner boundary.
